scheme_name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
other_conditions: The MSME unit must be engaged in the manufacturing sector.
The MSME unit must be in production during the scheme's operative period.
The MSME unit must apply within six months of exhibition participation.
Exhibitions/Trade fairs organized by industry associations, federations, chambers of commerce, State Government or its agency, or outside India are eligible.
International level exhibitions must be approved by the Ministry of MSME, ITPO, EEPC, FIEO or as approved by SLEC.
Participation limit: maximum 5 exhibitions (state, national, and international inside India) and maximum 3 exhibitions (international outside India) in total.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 75% of stall rent and up to ₹10,000‑₹20,000 for product literature and display material per exhibition (up to ₹5,00,000 for international outside India), subject to participation limits.
